testsuite.name: au.com.shiftyjelly.pocketcasts.voicecontrol.engine.VoiceAsrEngineTest

testcase.name: the engine drives REAL segment events through the observer - frozen context, no double gate check
translate fail blank and noop drop with ERROR earcon and skip intent
start with BluetoothA2dpOnly starts capture
a pipeline that never attaches reports termination
stop during an open segment CANCELS it - partial discarded, nothing completes
negative detection in WakeWord mode drops segment
a routing failure escalates to the cloud with the transcript verbatim
a pipeline that fails to attach reports the stream was not taken
asr log keeps source lang and text with english only in translate note
a capture inside the completion band is dropped as the wake word alone
only one escalation is dispatched per grace window
zh translation preserves source envelope for rewind phrase
a start that fails to attach closes the confirmed stream and leaves no active capture
a restarted engine prepares the ASR backend again
an empty transcript never reaches the cloud
wake-only detection opens grace and stays silent after an empty command transcript
an unprepared backend does not consume audio
gate OFF means the pipeline allocates NOTHING for upload across a full turn
a processing flow that ends reports termination
a local capability failure stays local and says so
start with WiredHeadset route skips SCO
a capture outside the completion band routes, because speech followed the wake word
wake word detection opens grace plays earcon and forwards full segment to ASR
a router that cannot load its model says so and does not escalate
a segment with no end sample is unknown, not wake-only
non-English transcript translated by stage before intent routing when backend cannot translate
a no_match from the room keeps the earcon and stays local
a no_match from a wake-detected segment speaks the unclear-command line
english transcript bypasses translation stage
transcription initializes recognizer before matching intent
stop keeps the backend warm rather than releasing it
start prepares the ASR backend
english transcript uses none translation kind with identical source and router
a bare wake phrase is rejected silently
a start that attaches hands the confirmed stream to the engine exactly once
canary result semantics yield backend envelope with configured source lang
a pipeline that attaches reports the start took the stream
start with Speaker route skips SCO and starts capture
